key_insight: A three-agent LLM loop can automatically tune only the critical components of specialized neural models while keeping the overall architecture fixed.
engineering_relevance: This offers a transferable workflow for improving domain-specific ML systems without full architecture search or manual hyperparameter tuning.
method: Analyst identifies the component to optimize and defines the tuning target.
Coder generates code only for the allowed model component inside a sandbox.
Recorder logs each trial, result, and decision to guide iterative refinement.
evidence_signal: Across five tasks, the system improved spiking classification on MNIST and Digits and reduced errors/drift dramatically on GNLSE and KS PDE benchmarks, including a ~2491-fold error reduction in one GNLSE run.
watch_item: Results depend on sandboxed code generation and a carefully constrained search space, so robustness may vary when components or task specifications are less clearly defined.
paper_title: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Automated Tuning of Specialized Neural Network Models
